objective: Determine the affine case complexity of retaining all product definitions or only their total XOR and test a direct decision algorithm under affine pins on the public reports, comparing shared-center and consecutive-pair overlap patterns.
status: Proved: Keeping all edge products requires exactly two to the minimum vertex-cover size in affine pieces; for their one checksum the exponent is half the polar rank. Affine pins on one checksum admit polynomial decision, k independent product combinations admit exact counting in 2^k times polynomial time, and individual product restrictions make the path NP-complete while stars stay polynomial.
title: Measure affine descriptions and decisions on growing connected AND checks
